title: Ceramics Studio Morning
prompt: A pottery studio in the morning: wooden shelves of handmade bowls and vases in varied glazes, a potter's wheel, tools, sunbeams through a window with dust motes drifting.
description: Throw varied hollow vessels from return profiles and establish the workshop with a lateral slide.
